eligibility: exactly three threshold clicks, all inside the six window modes, one per mode

preregistered.statistic: s = events in the suppressed set / collision-free three-click events inside the window
preregistered.suppressed_set: the 12 collision-free outputs whose slot labels do not sum to a multiple of 3
models: indistinguishable (Perceval NoiseModel at the HOM and g2 of the plan)
preregistered.interval: one-sided Student t interval over the per-iteration fractions of an arm, pooled over both jobs
preregistered.runs: one run per job name and every compilation seed once; a repeat of a failed job supersedes it with fresh QRNG seeds and is never pooled with it
preregistered.uncounted: missing, malformed and error iterations are tallied and skipped; the decision is undecided when an arm keeps fewer than min_iterations_per_arm iterations of at least min_accepted_events_per_iteration accepted events
preregistered.suppression_observed: both: upper 1 - alpha bound of s_periodic <= min(s_distinguishable, s_mean_field) - null_margin, and lower 1 - alpha bound of s_control - s_periodic >= contrast_margin
preregistered.control_valid: |mean s_control - s_control forecast of the indistinguishable model| <= control_tolerance
preregistered.level: |mean s_periodic - s_indistinguishable forecast| <= max(forecast_tolerance, 3 se); compile error and g2 raise s, so a deviation above the forecast is not evidence of partial distinguishability
preregistered.hom_lower_bound: the HOM at which the indistinguishable forecast equals the periodic mean; compile error raises s, so it bounds the effective HOM from below
preregistered.forecast_source: perfs_at_plan of submission.json, per-mode detection from t_out
